text:
inc-bot: Pager — billing-metering anomaly detected: token-count-drift p95 delta=+13.2% in eu1. Over 140 overage flags emitted. Severity: P2. Runbook: /runbooks/billing-drift. Link: https://ops.redwood/example/alerts/8001234567
amanda: ack oncall, I'm taking it. joining bridge in 2m
josh: what's the blast radius? any specific customers or models?
amanda: quick run -> `SELECT customer_id, region, delta_pct FROM metering.shadow_diff WHERE region='eu1' ORDER BY delta_pct DESC LIMIT 10;` shows ~150 customers with delta 9-20%, bulk around 12-15%.
priya: saw customer-email alerts already? do we need emergency mute of overage notifications?
josh: looking at emitter logs — delayed writes from kv-emitter consumer group `metering-eu1-emitter-v2`. consumer lag ~2.4M offsets. likely late ingestion causing shadow vs live mismatch.
inc-bot: Auto-mitigation: snapshot-fallback engaged for read-paths. Flagging suppression available at feature-flag `billing.suppress_overage_flags`.
amanda: let's mute flagging and stop automated billing notifications while we triage. priya, can you prepare that?
marco: support: we've got 7 tickets so far, CS already notified. I can send holding note if we mute flags.
lina: oncall checked kafka: one consumer partition stuck on broker eu1-3 with OOM-kick last night. Restarting consumer group should clear lag. I'll coordinate with josh.
josh: rolling restart of `metering-eu1-emitter` canary -> now. I will tail offsets.
amanda: assign: josh = restart emitter, lina = monitor offsets/kafka health, priya = pause notifications + prepare credits, marco = CS comms. I'll own coordination.
josh: restart issued at `2026-03-20T11:54:05Z`. tailing: lag -> 1.1M -> 450k -> 120k
inc-bot: Metrics update: overage-flag rate dropped 78% in 10m after suppress flagging + emitter restart. Lag trending down.
priya: paused `billing.suppress_overage_flags=true` -> confirmed. starting recon job to calculate true usage and candidate credits. Will open reconciliation run id `recon-800123`.
marco: drafted customer note and internal CS FAQ: https://docs.redwood/internal/cs/billing-drift-800123 (will update with credits ETA)
amanda: keep oncall for 2h to ensure stable. capture timeline in the postmortem doc: /incidents/INC-2026-045
josh: emitter lag at 0, consumers healthy. reconciliation finished: net token delta corrected; recalculated billing shows no systemic overcharge. pushing reconciliation report to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/recon-800123/report.csv
lina: kafka broker eu1-3 shows increased mem pressure; we've bumped JVM heap and scheduled a host reboot in maintenance window. no further impact observed.
priya: credits prepared for impacted subset (~150 accounts). Finance notified to apply in next billing cycle. Drafting a brief to send to customers.
marco: CS note sent to affected customers, included apology + credit mention. a few replies — none escalated to legal.
amanda: thanks team. I'll reduce severity to P3 and close the pager. please fill postmortem template and attach logs.
josh: attaching short logs snippet:
```
[11:54:05] restart emitter
[11:56:18] consumer lag 450k
[12:03:42] consumer lag 0
[12:05:01] recon job completed: 0.8% net correction (within threshold)
```
inc-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> severity P3. Incident ticket INC-2026-045 created. Reminder: 7-day follow-up postmortem due.
amanda: :thumbsup: will schedule postmortem review for tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
